annotator: single annotator, hand-written from the fetched transcripts
notes: gold_substring is an exact phrase copied from the transcript passage that answers the question.
Matching is whitespace-normalised and case-insensitive because YouTube captions carry arbitrary line breaks.
Digit group separators are stripped before matching, so 13,000 and 13000 are equivalent.
answer_keywords entries: a string must be present; a nested list means any one of its alternatives counts.
